name: FM-bench-verified
description:
Introduction
	

This dataset FM-Bench-Verified is a manual-cleaned and verified benchmark which contains 280 C programs, properties under verification, together with ground-truth ACSL specifications. 
This dataset can be used for:

Specification generation task (Code2Proof): given program and properties to be verified as input, output program with specification that can pass the prover.

It comes from three sources: 

FM-bench
AutoSpec
Github repositories


	
	
	
		Statistics of… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/fm-universe/FM-bench-verified.
reputation: A curated, manually verified benchmark valued in the formal-methods and program-verification community for evaluating specification-generation and prover success on real C programs.
